summary: Tested the Self Journey guide (/self-journey/:step) end to end on the backend and the frontend, using fresh registered parents (concern path and clear path) and parent1 for read-only checks. Backend: the 7 existing tests plus 9 new public-URL tests all pass. Frontend: one CRITICAL bug found and fixed. The Child Needs overlay showed a blank screen with no way back, because ChildNeedsView/JourneyPage already portals itself as a fixed z-50 page and was wrapped in a second fixed z-50 .sj-overlay with an opaque background that sat on top of it. After the fix the Educational form shows and cn-back returns to the guide. Every other requested flow worked as specified.

ui_bugs.issue: FIXED by testing agent. sj-needs-overlay rendered as an empty lavender full-screen with no back button. The opaque .sj-overlay portal covered ChildNeedsView's own portal. The wrapper is now a plain <div data-testid='sj-needs-overlay'> with no portal and no fixed position.

integration_issues.issue: For a parent who has not yet accepted the AI notice, the first tap on a chip or Send opens the notice. After ai-notice-continue the question is dropped and the parent has to tap again. confirmSend returns false after openNotice. This is app-wide AiNoticeProvider behaviour, but here it is a small friction.

issues: The global crisis strip ('In danger? Call 911…') and the site footer ('Privacy Notice', 'Who can see my information') appear in print. No private data, but consider hiding them in @media print.
Summary's 'N area(s) explored' counts only the accordions open right now. Collapsing an area lowers the count, so it reads as un-exploring it.

action_items: Review the testing agent's fix in SelfJourneyPage.jsx (needs overlay no longer double-portalled). Keep it, or apply the same idea differently.
Optional: after the AI notice is accepted, automatically send the question the parent first tapped.

Optional: editing the Foundation draft after approval (or tapping 'Approved ✓') un-approves only in local state. It is not persisted until Next/Save, and the old text stays in /api/foundation-builder/me. Consider auto-saving the un-approve or making it clear to the parent.
Optional: typed answers are saved only on Next or 'Save & finish later'. A reload before that loses them. Consider debounced autosave.
Optional: hide the crisis strip and site footer in print.
critical_code_review_comments: SelfJourney.jsx is 916 lines. Split it into step components and an AssistantSheet module.
Opening any overlay from the guide is fine for SA/CP (each portals itself). Don't wrap the portal-based views in another fixed overlay. That was the root cause of the blank screen.
FoundationPage toggleApproved un-approves with one click and no confirmation or persist.
verified: /journey Step 1 card (journey-flow-step-self, a button that navigates) opens /self-journey. /self-journey redirects to the furthest step, and a new parent lands on /safety. (A first-time parent sees the path-picker modal on /journey first.)

Safety: title correct. sj-next is disabled until a pick. The check-in link is <a target=_blank rel=noopener> to https://sacoparentsalign.com/ for a new parent. For parent1 it is https://sacoparentsalign.com/check-in?case=SA-783115: an SA case code, not an align_ref. /family-checkin/link returns parent1's joint case SA-783115 rather than SA-DEMO01. The clear and concern notices show (tel:911, tel:18007997233). The CTA changes to 'Continue on My Safety Pathway'.
Next saves and shows a toast. Save-later shows a toast. Reload keeps typed answers. A URL to an unreached step redirects. Back and progress-segment jumps work, and unreached segments are disabled.
Self-Assessment overlay opens, and sa-back returns to the same step. Co-Parenting overlay opens, and cp-back returns with cp-agree kept.

Concern path: coparenting shows the concern notice and offers only parallel and unsure. Mediation shows sj-mediation-concern. Clear path offers all three approaches. Switching to concern drops cooperative (server says approach=null).
Child Needs: accordions toggle (aria-expanded). sj-open-special-needs has href /special-needs-v2. The Educational overlay works after the fix.

Foundation: Draft, then edit, then Approve shows the toast 'Saved as your Foundation Statement.' GET /api/foundation-builder/me fields.statement equals the draft. 'Approved ✓' survives a reload. Editing afterwards un-approves.

Summary: shows statuses only, and no Situation, Mediation or co-parenting note text appears on it or on /summary. The statement shows in sj-summary-statement. sj-edit-1/3/6 navigate to the right step. Download PDF calls window.print once. Under print media, 'Safety pathway options' and 'safety concerns' are hidden and the row shows 'Completed'.

Guide: header, help and sheet avatars are circles (border-radius 50%), /images/guide-avatar.webp, picture in purple, dark blue and white. data-spins goes 0→1→2 with animationName sj-spin (0.9s). Real AI replies arrived. The second question reused session_id. Payload is only message and section, with no private notes. Escape and sj-assistant-close both close the sheet.
Calm Mode: PUT {on:true} gives root class 'sj is-calm' and the avatar animationName is 'none' after asking. It was reset to false afterwards.

Layout: no horizontal overflow on any of the 8 steps at 390x844 or 1920x800. The crisis strip is visible. Footer, help button and sheet bottoms sit above the strip (390: footer and sheet bottom at 800, strip top at 806. 1920: 756 vs 775).

success_rate.frontend: ~95% (1 critical bug found and fixed, plus minor UX notes)
